bank.retain_mission: Extract UI component specifications, design system tokens (colors, typography, spacing), responsive layout rules, accessibility constraints, animation guidelines, and visual feedback notes. Ignore raw HTML boilerplate.
bank.observations_mission: Track design system evolution, component hierarchy, brand visual guidelines, and UI feedback history over time.
bank.reflect_mission: Synthesize a visual design specification detailing component patterns, brand colors, typography, accessibility rules, and layout constraints.

mental_models.name: Design System Tokens & Components
mental_models.source_query: What are the project's design system tokens, color palettes, typography, button/card styles, and component patterns?

mental_models.name: Responsive Layout & Accessibility Rules
mental_models.source_query: What are the responsive breakpoint rules, flex/grid layouts, dark mode preferences, and ARIA/accessibility guidelines?
